title: %split — split and select one element
purpose: Split a string on a delimiter and return the element at a given index.
notes: Three required arguments: string, delimiter, then the zero-based index to select.
Negative indices count from the end. Out-of-range indices return null. Use %tokenize to get the whole array.

avoid.why: omitting the index argument fails the 3-argument requirement and yields null (~); %split returns a single element, not the array
